signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own a scoped area of the product from problem framing through prototyping, rollout, and measurement
Ship and experiment fast: try ideas with customers, keep what sticks, drop what doesn't
Talk directly with security engineers, platform teams, and developers, and translate what you learn into clear product direction
Use AI relentlessly to prototype and speed up your own work and help the whole team do the same
Turn ambiguous, technical problems into simple, well-reasoned specs that engineering, customers, and leadership can all act on
